text:
Sam: Heads-up — PR #18402 is blocked by a recurring CI failure on integration shard-7. Hit 3x in the last 24h after the rebase. Root log snippet below; looks like a KV timeout followed by a panic in CI only.

Sam: ```
kv_cache_test.go:142: timeout waiting for rehydrate
panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer dereference
goroutine 112 [running]:
...
```

CI-Bot: build 18402 shard-7 failed: exit status 2. @Sam you can run `ci retry --targeted 18402 --shard=7`

Priya: I'll queue a targeted rerun now. If it passes twice we can merge, otherwise we need a deeper look. tagging @Jon for potential race.

Priya: ci-bot rerun triggered: https://buildkite.example/teams/redwood/builds/98765 :running:

Jon: My hunch: the PR touched kv eviction order and there may be a race between the rehydrate timer and compaction. Suggest adding a short mutex + instrumented metric to validate.

Alex: If this only flakes on shard-7 (aws-us-west), could be infra noise too. @Tara can you check node images / kernel?

Tara: Checking node pool autoscaler and kernel version now — nothing obvious so far. I filed infra ticket #874 and left notes.

Sam: Plan: two targeted reruns. If both green, merge and open a follow-up to harden eviction timing. If still flaky, revert the tweak and debug with a repro harness.

CI-Bot: build 98765 (rerun) finished: PASS on shard-7 :white_check_mark:

Priya: Pass 1 of 2. Queueing second targeted rerun.

CI-Bot: build 98766 (rerun) finished: PASS on shard-7 :white_check_mark:

Alex: Two greens. @Sam please merge and add a follow-up ticket to add a targeted test for eviction timing. Also add label `ci:flaky-watch` to the PR.

Sam: Merging now. Thanks all :rocket:
